reviews.review_msg: Do not take REM334. This is the single most textbook heavy and reliant class I have ever taken. The entire premise of her "lectures" are going over what the textbook says. You could literally only read the textbook and never show up to lecture and ace this class. Quizzes, in class assignments, 3 exams, 1 final. All depends on how much you read.

Dont take REM 334 with her if you want to have a life. Weekly quizzes, lots of textbook readings, 2 midterms, a research paper, and a final. This class would've been somewhat more enjoyable if she didn't cram a textbook worth of information in 1 semester. Hard pass, will not recommend her or this class to anyone.

Even though I received over 90% in coursework, I still ended with a B+ due to my participation. If you are not comfortable talking in front of 60+ people, do not take a course with her! She marks participation very heavily. It was an interesting course, but frustrating to get this mark after all the reading and effort I put in.
